links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified NHS oral cancer patient information texts
links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL, GFI, CLI, SMOG) of LLM-simplified vs original texts, with content fidelity
links.effect: LLM revisions significantly improved all five indices (p < 0.0001); mean FRES of originals 66.4 ± 7.7 vs Claude 81.6 ± 6.2 (only model above the 80 benchmark); proposed leaflet FRES 65.7 rose to 81.2 with Claude; LSA means 0.97, 0.94, 0.96; character 3-5-g cosine 0.85, 0.80, 0.82
links.tradeoff: Content fidelity was slightly reduced (character 3-5-g cosine 0.80-0.85), and only Claude reached the FRES 80 benchmark; authors note human oversight is needed.
links.quote: LLM-revisions significantly improved readability across all five indices (p < 0.0001).

design_hint: LLM readability simplification of patient education materials with content fidelity checks
